title: Role of Intravenous Versus Home Oral Antibiotics in Perforated Appendicitis
brief_summary: To compare the effect of a single-agent home intravenous (IV) versus oral antibiotic therapy on complication rates and resource utilization following appendectomy for perforated appendicitis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients 4-17 years of age with perforated acute appendicitis diagnosed at time of appendectomy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a known severe allergy to penicillin (anaphylaxis), prior severe side effects from ertapenem or amoxicillin-clavulanate, pregnancy, or previous drainage procedure for abscess and/or fluid collection related to appendicitis.
